parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4 that have an indication for hypertension. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter drug_indication.mesh_heading to match 'hypertension'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles (INNER JOIN compound_structures), indication_curie (EFO ID), indication_label (EFO term), and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
